page.overview:
Who is Forsaken Garden Party?

The Forsaken Garden Party is a term used by fans to refer to the meeting called by Moridin in Tel'aran'rhiod of the surviving Forsaken. It takes place during Knife of Dreams, Chapter 3, and is so-named because Graendal molds Tel'aran'rhiod into an image of the Ansaline Gardens from the Age of Legends upon her arrival.
